title: Property overview
body: Four-bedroom craftsman on a quarter-acre lot, rebuilt from the studs in 2019. New roof, new mechanicals, 200-amp service. South-facing garden with mature fruit trees. Walk score 71.

title: A note from the current owners
body: We are looking for someone who will love this house the way we have. Tell us about yourselves — write us a letter about your family, what brought you to the area, and what this home would mean to you. The offer that moves us most is the one we will take.

title: About the neighbourhood
body: A quiet, family-oriented street that has stayed close-knit for decades. Two churches within walking distance and a well-regarded parish school at the corner. The block has kept its original character and the long-established families who built it.

title: Fair housing notice
body: This brokerage complies with the federal Fair Housing Act and RCW 49.60. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, familial status, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, or veteran status. All are welcome to view, make offers on, and purchase this property.

title: Offer instructions
body: Submit offers to the listing agent by 5pm Friday. Include proof of funds and a pre-approval letter. Escalation clauses accepted. Inspection contingencies should be waived where possible to keep the timeline tight.

title: Systems and utilities
body: Gas forced-air furnace (2019), 50-gallon water heater (2021), and a 2019 architectural composition roof. Sewer scoped in March and reported clear. Average monthly utilities $180.

title: Meet the sellers and next steps
body: Our family has raised three children in this home and we would love to see another young family carry that on — send us a personal note about yours along with your offer. The neighbourhood suits churchgoing families especially well. Offers due Friday; contact the listing agent for the disclosure packet.
